unresolved_added: The two-factor AHP matrix reports lambda=2.0000 together with CR=0.2496; those values are inconsistent under the stated consistency formula.
Prose calls some three- and four-factor comparison matrices two-factor matrices, leaving the hierarchy description internally inconsistent.
The male=1 and female=3 coding uses an unsupported gender rationale and should not be transferred as an evidence-backed comparison rule.
Grey normalization prose confuses min and max cases and changes the evaluated entity from coaches to countries.
The Fuzzy table duplicates d13 and omits d14, so the grade or membership index cannot be safely reused without source reconciliation.
The final fuzzy expression uses Z=B D^T although D is defined as five elements and B earlier denotes top-level weights, creating a dimensional and semantic conflict.
The paper says Fuzzy evaluation both considers and does not consider internal relationships, so the claimed distinction is unresolved.
The time index (T-1900)/100 and seven-percent weight are weakly sourced and systematically favor later-starting coaches under the stated convention.
Changing only the maximum weight by plus or minus 0.02 supports conditional rank sensitivity, not indicator validation, parameter robustness, model validation, or external validity.
Comparison with Wikipedia or current ranks risks circular validation and candidate-selection bias when the same ecosystem supplies the inputs or benchmark.
The conclusion attributes data to NCAA while the body cites Wikipedia and sports websites, leaving the actual data provenance unreconciled.
Appendix reports Harry Statham wins as 1076 while an earlier matrix reports 1079.
MATLAB or computer simulation is claimed without code, configuration, input data, or reproducible outputs.

validation_results.details: All 36/36 physical pages have extracted text and preserved rendered coverage; the completed visual review is backed by six byte-bounded consecutive-page JPEG proxies and two targeted formula/table crops.
128 language units cover all 16 unique declared protocol chapters with quantitative layouts, reusable slots, variants, and boundaries.
128/128 units passed against the full source text with no failed original-instantiation checks.
8 model and algorithm interfaces retain 14 source-anchored equations plus inputs, conditions, handoffs, validation links, and limitations.
16 five-part chapter contracts, the Abstract and Introduction paragraph chains, positive organization artifacts, 12 visual dispositions, and 13 last-pass warnings passed.
The paper card, 393 observations, cumulative B rules, extraction, language/model records, and complete visual review cross-validate.

12 nominated B rules received source-matched Queue 101 evidence without lifecycle changes; staged and live canonical outputs are byte-identical at 89f2fe6ee10f27753269cf5556e76e050f454c5f29acd99bd0a2332b6acd6be1.
The live plan retains language-first G0-G8 ordering and prospective/live transaction ordering.
All 119 regression tests pass against the promoted Queue 101 bytes.

Archived 413 events were analyzed only with bounded metadata; the largest legacy session line was about 15.4 million characters. Queue 101 used no image transport in its final validation, and its earlier visual evidence used single JPEG proxies at or below 450,000 bytes without original-page PNG transmission.
